contentTier.description: Answers what type of content this entity is. Independent of publication state.

definitions.T1_DEAL: Commercial discounted deal with verifiable listed price, total cost, conditions, and validity window.
definitions.T2_PROGRAM: Institutional or official program with educational/professional documentation from official body.
definitions.T3_PLACE: Physical community, civic, or cultural location/amenity with verified operating body and public access.
definitions.T4_RADAR: Non-commercial demand-tracking radar item observing market hypotheses without prices, vouchers, or purchase decisions.

admissionState.description: Answers whether this entity is published or where it sits in the admission lifecycle. Independent of tier.

definitions.OPEN_EVALUATING: Entity is currently undergoing active SLA evaluation from raw evidence.
definitions.EVIDENCE_COMPLETE_INTERNAL_HELD: Entity has proven raw evidence and locators for required fields, but is held internal awaiting Council review and CEO authorization.
definitions.HELD_NEW_COHORT_REQUIRED: Entity closed its SLA window with missing fields. SLA is expired and closed; reopening requires a fresh cohort, new capture, and new audit trail.
definitions.CLOSED: Entity failed intake, had invalid provenance, expired terms, or was permanently rejected fail-closed.
definitions.PUBLIC_APPROVED: Entity has been explicitly approved for public storefront rendering via a formal written CEO decision with valid CEO approval ID.

T1_DEAL.rules: Missing any required field or locator strictly prevents T1 classification or PUBLIC_APPROVED admission.

T4_RADAR.rules: T4 must describe an auditable tracking rationale. Storing or rendering any forbidden commercial field is strictly prohibited.

admission_policy.public_approved_rule: PUBLIC_APPROVED state can ONLY be assigned if a valid ceo_approval_id is present and traceable to canonical CEO directive.
